subject.title: build(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group with 9 updates

question: Should ClawHub accept this grouped production dependency upgrade as one merge, or split the runtime-sensitive packages before landing?
rationale: The patch is mechanically clean and CI is green, but dependency compatibility risk across Convex, Sharp, Mermaid/Shiki, Resend, and Tailwind is a maintainer risk-tolerance call rather than an automated code repair.

options.title: Approve grouped upgrade
options.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance of the residual compatibility risk covered by CI, CodeQL, secret scanning, and the Vercel preview.

options.title: Split risky packages
options.body: Ask for separate updates for Convex, Sharp, Mermaid/Shiki, and Resend if maintainers want smaller rollback units.

options.title: Hold dependency sweep
options.body: Pause or close this grouped PR if maintainers prefer waiting for newer targeted updates or upstream stability signals.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer acceptance of the residual compatibility risk covered by CI, CodeQL, secret scanning, and the Vercel preview.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current dependency baseline and CODEOWNERS for the backend/package surfaces most affected by the grouped upgrade.
